title: ArtifactOperationRequestContext
description: Caller-owned request context for Preview, Edit and Conversion outside a WorkOrder. Platform admission allocates the ArtifactOperation and derives Policy, Budget, Permissions, Gateway and Provider bindings after authentication.
x-semantic-constraints: request_digest is RFC 8785 JCS SHA-256 over the complete operation request excluding operation_context.request_digest
tenant_id, client_app_id, principal_context, ArtifactVersion, requested Capability, immutable CommercialAuthorization and QuotaReservation are caller-owned admission inputs

artifact_operation_id, PolicyDecision, ExecutionBudget, EffectivePermissions, Artifact Gateway binding, ProviderResolution and Invocation are Platform-owned admission facts and are rejected when supplied by the caller
idempotency scope is Tenant plus ClientApplication plus operation kind plus idempotency-key digest; a reused key with another request digest conflicts
for Agent Access Preview, Edit and Conversion routes, operation_context.artifact_id exactly equals the authenticated artifact_id path parameter before admission or object lookup
